# Event Ability

Source: [wiki article 9595](../archive/9595.md); edited 2026-08-30.

Exact pinned API: [Event Ability](../../api/values/event-ability.md).

<a id="wiki-9595-n1"></a>

- Event Ability applies to elimination/final blow/damage/death/healing/knockback events.

<a id="wiki-9595-n2"></a>

- This older article contains a known-bug table where some abilities return Null or another button, and notes that bleed may retain its originating ability attribution. For the current exception list, follow the newer OW2 Changes/Bugs registry in article 9463.
